# travelprep-mcp

> Trip preparation MCP server: Airbnb + Booking.com search (subprocess-wrapped, no paid API keys) plus free-source destination info (Wikipedia, Wikivoyage, Open-Meteo, REST Countries).

## Tools

- `stays(operation, provider, ...)` -- search or get details for Airbnb/Booking.com listings
- `hotel_extras(operation, ...)` -- Booking.com-only extras: find_hotels, compare, check_availability, reviews, price_calendar
- `destination(operation, place, forecast_days)` -- overview / weather / practical info for a place
- `account(operation)` -- Booking.com account: login, trips, wishlist, rewards
